info.headline: Baodi District Meteorological Observatory issues yellow warning for heavy fog/level III/severe
info.description: The Baodi District Meteorological Observatory issued a yellow warning signal for heavy fog at 19:25 on November 11, 2026: It is expected that from tonight to tomorrow morning, all streets and towns in our district will experience fog with visibility less than 1 kilometer, some areas with visibility less than 500 meters, and some areas with visibility less than 200 meters. Relevant units and personnel are requested to be prepared for prevention.

info.headline: 宝坻区气象台发布大雾黄色预警/Ⅲ级/较重
info.description: 宝坻区气象台于2026年11月11日19时25分发布大雾黄色预警信号：预计今天夜间到明天早晨，我区所有街镇将出现能见度小于1千米的雾，部分地区能见度小于500米，局地能见度不足200米，请有关单位和人员做好防范准备。
